staggered.name: Staggered
staggered.description: The next heavy attack deals bonus damage.

exposed.name: Exposed
exposed.description: The next slash attack is a guaranteed critical hit.

off_balance.name: Off Balance
off_balance.description: The next shield bash deals bonus damage or may stun.

rushing.name: Rushing
rushing.description: The next sword attack is a guaranteed critical hit.

guarding.name: Guarding
guarding.description: The next enemy attack triggers a riposte.

marked.name: Marked
marked.description: The next infused attack has a higher elemental proc chance.

raised_shield.name: Raised Shield
raised_shield.description: The next enemy attack is heavily blocked.

sheathed.name: Sheathed
sheathed.description: Cannot attack. Counters the next enemy melee attack with a powerful iaijutsu strike.

last_moment.name: Last Moment
last_moment.description: If HP would drop below 20%, automatically parry the attack.

deflect.name: Deflect
deflect.description: Reduce the next attack and reflect part of it back.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.description: After taking damage, next turn's first attack deals +40% damage.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: After taking damage, the next attack heals for a portion of its damage.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.description: If not hit this enemy turn, next attack deals +80% damage.
